metaDescription: NOT REVEALED. Closest paraphrase from [a]: a Bitcoin-backed loan is a facility where the borrower pledges Bitcoin to raise funds while keeping ownership of the coins; typically short-term bridging; LTV typically 30-50%.
summary: Silver Oak Capital's Bitcoin Loans Advisory page describes Bitcoin-backed loans: the borrower pledges Bitcoin to raise funds while keeping ownership of the coins; the facilities are typically short-term bridging loans (some lenders may offer longer terms); LTV is conservative at 30-50% because of Bitcoin's volatility; interest rates are higher than traditional asset-backed loans; the Bitcoin is typically held in third-party custody or a lender-controlled wallet; funds are advanced in fiat (USD, EUR, GBP) or occasionally stablecoins. The sister page /crypto-bridging-advisory/ quotes an LTV cap of 60% or lower and flags margin calls. No H1, meta, fees, loan sizes, process steps, FAQ or CTA text for this specific page was surfaced. Search (c) returned no Silver Oak Capital content at all.
